# Official openGrid board provenance

Author: **David D** (@DavidD). Publisher listing: https://www.printables.com/model/1214361-opengrid-walldesk-mounting-framework-and-ecosystem/files

License: **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**. Source licensing and attribution must be retained when redistributing or modifying these files.

The original Full and Lite 2×2 / 4×4 3MF files, and three available matching STEP originals, were downloaded directly from the original publisher's Printables-hosted file links. `manifest.json` records each original file's Printables file ID, direct publisher URL, byte size, SHA-256, and Git blob SHA, and distinguishes the four board sizes/variants.

Files in `boards/` are byte-for-byte originals. The GitHub Actions build checks their hashes and basic dimensions before creating independent GLB viewer exports and PNG previews. These conversion outputs are visualization artifacts, not new official designs.

The Full 4×4 STEP remains available from the publisher at https://www.printables.com/model/1214361-opengrid-walldesk-mounting-framework-and-ecosystem/files but is not included in this repository. The 3MF Full 4×4 original **is** included.

No physical fit, strength, load, or slicer testing was conducted by this repo.
